program: tutorial triage bundle, recorded and compiled fresh
loop: AutoRepair over SelfRepair (bridge up to 3), no standard-change policy
approver: benchmark:scripted-approver (stands in for a person; approves all)

modes.grow: four new referrals above the target
modes.rename: Open -> View, Save Encounter -> Submit Encounter
modes.relink: New Encounter -> Start visit, new id, moved
modes.redesign: Save -> Submit to chart, new id, moved; decoy Submit feedback
modes.menu: Save moved into Actions > Billing > Submit encounter
modes.provider: new required Ordering provider screen before the form
modes.reqfield: new required Acuity field on the form
modes.notice: an interstitial notice replaces the tasks screen once
modes.modal: a blocking modal replaces the saved confirmation
modes.lookalike: a look-alike referral above the target
